scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test

conditions.routeTypes: pnpm exec next typegen before manifests, error and timing runs (production build phase config load)

typescript6Caches.full: --incremental false: no build info read or written
typescript6Caches.cached: primed --tsBuildInfoFile under .cache/typecheck-benchmark-t01; no source change between samples
typescript6Caches.edited: separate primed build info; src/features/finishedGoods/unitNextAction.ts gains a new unique export before each sample and is restored after it
typescript6Caches.commandCached: pnpm typecheck:ts6 with the project's default tsconfig.tsbuildinfo, primed before timing

conditions.bun: bun --check never reads or writes build info: every run checks the whole project
conditions.filesystem: warm; dependencies installed by pnpm install --frozen-lockfile before the run
conditions.concurrency: one process at a time; no other build, test or benchmark started by this task during the run; other workstation activity uncontrolled (1-minute load average recorded per sample)

provenance.replaces: untracked pilot scripts/benchmark-typecheck.mjs from the checker worktree
